name: Windscribe ScribeForce
summary: Windscribe's team offering costs $5 per seat a month with a five-seat minimum. One account page adds and removes users, and revoking access takes effect at once. Shared static IPs are sold as add-ons at $2 to $8 a month, and the page gives no separate price for dedicated ones.

facts.text: Windscribe says it uses AES-256 encryption with OpenVPN, WireGuard and IKEv2.
Shared static IPs cost $2 to $8 a month and are needed only when internal tools require IP allowlisting.
Accounts need at least five seats and support up to 500 users.
Admins add or remove users from one dashboard, the team is billed on one invoice, and a revoked seat can go to someone else.

plans.name: ScribeForce
plans.notes: Minimum 5 seats. The page does not say whether this rate depends on the billing term.

hiddenCosts: Shared static IPs cost $2 to $8 a month on top of the seat price.
